notes: Price status rules: Elevated if above max(75th percentile, $150); Spike if above max(95th percentile, $300) or above $500.
Lambda rules: Watch at ≥300; Stressed at ≥500.
Demand rules: Watch above the 90th percentile; Stressed above the 95th percentile (based on the last 7 days).
Outage rule: “Unusually high” if above the 90th percentile (last 7 days).
This is a conservative indicator meant to answer: “Are conditions getting tight?” It is not an emergency alert system.
